summary: Full frontend audit of CareerCase (https://careercase.pages.dev). Tested 25+ routes across desktop (1280x800) and mobile (375x812). Hero fix confirmed working — word-cloud backdrop visible, no THREE.js crash. Critical bug found: /explore route returns 404 despite EXPLORE being the primary nav link. Three pages (/job, /simulation, /interview-prep) silently redirect to home without user feedback.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /explore renders 404 'Page not filed'. The EXPLORE link is prominently in navbar on all pages. No route or page component exists for /explore. This is P0 — core nav link is dead.

/simulation, /interview-prep, /job all silently redirect to / (home) with no error message or guidance. Users get no feedback — just arrive at home page with no explanation. These pages should show a 'Select a career first' or similar prompt instead of silent redirect.

Heading text_content() returns duplicate concatenated text without spaces e.g. 'Assessment deskAssessmentdesk'. Likely caused by an aria-label or hidden span duplicating the visible text inside the heading element. May affect screen readers.
On mobile (375px) the hero word-cloud area appears blank/gray on initial screenshot (first paint), then renders correctly after ~1.5s. May be a font/canvas loading delay on lower-end mobile.

integration_issues.flow: AI features (Counselor, Mood Match, Career Transition, Roadmap, Quiz, Interview Prep)
integration_issues.issue: Counselor shows graceful fallback 'The counselor service is unavailable right now' — EXPECTED per agent note (VITE_AI_PROXY_URL not set). Mood Match, Career Transition, Roadmap, Quiz load UI correctly but AI responses not tested as proxy unavailable.

issues: Design is clean and consistent with newsprint aesthetic. Playfair Display font loads correctly. Breadcrumb visible on inner pages. Color contrast appears good — dark ink on off-white paper.

PASS: / (Home) — hero loads, word-cloud, stick figure, CTAs present
/counselor — chat interface, graceful AI unavailable message
/mood — textarea, mood chips, Find my careers button
/career-transition — from/to fields, Map My Transition button
/passport — 'No passport yet' state with Start onboarding
/pathway/:id — 'Start onboarding first' gate, no THREE.js crash
Language switcher — Hindi UI changes navbar + hero text
Mobile 375px — bottom nav visible, hero renders

action_items: CRITICAL: Add /explore route — create ExplorePage component or redirect to a valid career search page. The EXPLORE nav link is used by all users and currently dead.
HIGH: /simulation, /interview-prep, /job should show an informative 'Please select a career first' state instead of silently redirecting to home. Add a guard component with CTA.
LOW: Investigate duplicate text in H1/H2 elements (aria-label + visible text concatenation issue).
LOW: Investigate mobile hero first-paint blank area — consider adding a CSS skeleton or ensuring canvas initialises before font load completes.
critical_code_review_comments: The EXPLORE nav item (visible in routes.ts and Navbar) likely points to /explore but no route is registered — this is a missing route definition. Check routes.ts for '/explore' entry and confirm the page component exists.

/job, /simulation, /interview-prep likely use React Router's useLocation state to receive a career object. When navigated directly (no state), they redirect to / — this is correct guard logic but needs a user-friendly message instead of silent redirect.
AI-dependent features show proper graceful degradation when VITE_AI_PROXY_URL is absent — good defensive coding.
